messages.label: replay to rp 'N': freeze snapshot into pending slot

cards.title: The horizon switch is a memcpy
items: DRServedSnapshotPublish copies pending → served in each node's shared memory, iff the names match
procarray and latestCompletedXid never move; nothing global is rewound
Readers pick up the new image on their next GetSnapshotData() call

cards.title: Reads never stop
items: Queries stay answerable through the whole switch — on the old cut N-1 until publish
Publish is dispatched only after every node is paused at N: segments first, then the QD
So no node serves N while a lagging node still serves N-1

cards.title: Ordering rules
items: Arm before resume: resuming first lets a node free-run to end of WAL
A node already paused at 'N' is left alone; arming ahead of production is how you catch a point cleanly
Re-running with the current point is a cheap re-publish — how a restarted node gets its image back
